Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document
out lines the Equipment Minor Inspection Procedure P1, which must be performed from two 
to three years 
as indicated by Y2:3 in the title block for the minimum oil circuit breaker:
- Rated Voltage: 66kv - Rated current: 2500A 
- Short circuit current: 3l.5KA/1sec
The first draft initiated by eng. Samer Ayad at Sabtia 
I 220kv Cairo.
Safety Precautions
CB must be
isolated completely and grounded on both sides,
Ensure that
the earthing switch must be connected on both sides of the CB.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence
(rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area, safety around the work
place.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses, use only
fiberglass ladders,
Isolate the DC
Control voltage.

Environmental Precautions
Dont burn cloth.
Used in cleaning but collect and send to the dump for proper disposal.
Tools and Equipment
Spanner for
arcing tip, ring spanner, fork spanner size 19, gasket to ventilating lid,
A complete set
of tools, tools for checking dash pot, clamping device,
Hydraulic
oil if needed, silicon grease, cleaning cloth, blower,
Test mandrel
for arc control device.
Spanner for
arcing tip, ring spanner, fork spanner size 19, gasket to ventilating lid,
A complete set
of tools, tools for checking dash pot, clamping device,
Hydraulic
oil if needed, silicon grease, cleaning cloth, blower,
Test mandrel
for arc control device.
Work to be Carried Out
Drain
approximately 2 liters sump oil through oil tap (18) in humid and hot humid
atmosphere conditions,
Subsequently,
drain oil sample from breaker pole and test according to specification: 
 - The gap 2.5 mm
 - 30 kv-rms. Clean oil. - 25 kv-rms. 
 Oil in CB 
 - 15 kv-rms.
Used oil. 
 - 10 kv rms limits for satisfactory operation of the CB.
Remove
ventilating lid by turning spanner,
Top up with
fresh clean oil,
Smear gasket
to ventilating lid (38) with silicon grease,
Replace
ventilating lid.
